acceptance.explanation:
l36 is retained. All seven blue pins improve, with summed color and saturation error falling by 26.3%. Their B/G ratios rise by 2.6–3.6%. The largest earlier-pin color regression is 0.03032 in log-ratio error, inside the declared 0.035 guard. The photo remains more deeply blue and more mottled.

Only the three global young-material parameters change: R/G tint 0.62979, B/G tint 1.07289 and component saturation 1.21697. Geometry, density, catalogue photometry, object brightness, dust, the other component grades and the global display curve remain l32. The canonical linear-light output preserves photopic brightness to 3.6e-16. Tiny and 512-pixel views are complete and coherent. No rejected l35 gas enters this model.

independentReview.reviewer: Claude Code, independent read-only subscription review
independentReview.verdict: PASS. No P0 or P1; the source and completed-image measurements support retaining the color-only step.
rootVerifiedEvidence: All seven completed-image target scores improve; summed error falls 26.3%.
gates.mts sets the hard log-color guard to 0.035; the measured maximum is 0.03031608.
The actual B/G ratios rise 2.6–3.6%; full measurements are saved in calibration.json and pin-checks.json.
The 193-test suite passed before the additional default-parent regression; the final 194-test suite also passed.
Removing either l36 target selection or its l32 default parent fails the corresponding behavior test.
The default-parent correction makes both CLI entry points use l32 for l36 without explicit arguments.
Linear photopic brightness is preserved; encoded PNG brightness is not claimed identical.
limitations: The photo remains more saturated and more mottled.
No new structure, grain, dust or gas was introduced; l35 remains rejected.
independentReview.finalVerdict: No P0 or P1 remains. Retaining the color-only result is supported.
clarifications: The 0.03 soft guard is a fitting penalty; the separate 0.035 hard guard controls retention.
